name: Cloud of Razors, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level antipaladin 1, bloodrager 1, inquisitor 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (1 small razor)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 5)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a multitude of razors that cut the flesh of the target creature dealing 1 slashing damage per round at the beginning of their turn. They may make a Fortitude save to negate the damage for the round. A critical failure on this saving throw doubles the damage for the round while a critical success ends the spell altogether. The slashing damage dealt is physical and is subject to DR. The razors disappear when the duration expires.
